display.title: Episode 237: The Stone for the Beis HaMikdash (Erev Rosh Chodesh Av)
display.summary_short: A music-free Three Weeks show: Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa's stone for the Beis HaMikdash, why Rosh Chodesh is the 'head' of the month, a listener's letter, and a call for Ahavas Yisroel.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on Erev Rosh Chodesh Av 5746, in the middle of the Three Weeks, so no music is played. Uncle Yossi explains that the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed because Jews failed to love one another, and that Ahavas Yisroel will rebuild it. Story time: Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa is too poor to bring a gift for the Beis HaMikdash, until he finds a perfectly square stone. It is far too heavy to move, but five angels disguised as travelers offer help; the stone floats only when he adds his own little finger. The story is split by the Shema, led by a young Tzivos Hashem member who likes signing up his friends. Lessons: every mitzvah adds a stone to the third Beis HaMikdash, and 'you try your best and Hashem will do the rest'. Uncle Yossi explains why Rosh Chodesh is the 'head' of the month, then reads a letter from two Beis Yaakov girls describing their Shavuos picture of Har Sinai. He closes with the Alter Rebbe's teaching that Hashem, like a parent, delights when His children love each other, a call to sign up new members, and an invitation to send in poems and essays.
display.lesson: Try your best and Hashem will do the rest; every mitzvah adds a stone to the third Beis HaMikdash.
